messages:
maria: quick flag — while updating the runtime guide I hit a 404. deep link `/runtime/kv-cache#lifecycle-management` resolves to a 404. can the docs owners take a look? :eyes:
jamal: thanks for the ping. which page had the bad anchor?
maria: the runtime -> kv-cache section, from the 'caching & lifecycle' callout near the top. link text is `#lifecycle-management` but the heading is `Lifecycle` (so anchor mismatch).
docs-bot: automated link-scan found 1 broken internal anchor on /runtime/kv-cache (severity: low). See scan: https://internal-ci/reports/link-scan/1750012345
sasha: I can do a quick PR to change the anchor link to `#lifecycle`. should be a one-line md tweak.
chris: +1, please do. also can we add a short unit test or a quick link-check step to the docs pipeline for that page? we've had a few of these regressions.
sasha: will open PR in a min. command I used locally to find anchors: `rg "#lifecycle|lifecycle-management" -n docs/ | sed -n '1,40p'`
ryan: quick question — is this a content change only or did the heading intentionally change in a previous PR? want to avoid reverting someone's refactor. :thinking_face:
maria: good call. I looked at the git history — heading was changed in https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/3f2c9 last month. the heading intentionally shortened. so update link is the right move.
jamal: tagging owners for the runtime section: @sasha @ryan — pls review the incoming PR when Sasha posts it.
sasha: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 — replaces `#lifecycle-management` -> `#lifecycle` and adds a tiny test to `docs/scripts/link-check.sh` to assert anchors on that page.
chris: nice, thank you. can you add a changelog line in the PR description (one-liner) so release notes capture this micro-fix?
sasha: done. added changelog note and a short test. CI looks green on my fork.
docs-bot: PR 4123 opened by sasha. automated link-checker passed. preview available: https://staging-docs.redwood.ai/runtime/kv-cache#lifecycle
ryan: reviewing now. if all good I'll approve and merge.
maria: awesome, appreciate the fast turnaround. once merged can someone confirm Sentry link alerts for docs don't fire on this type of small anchor change? we get noisy alerts sometimes.
jamal: i'll follow up with infra to mute the noisy ones for anchor-only 404s. filing a tiny ops ticket after merge. :thumbsup:
ryan: approved and merged. shipping to prod in next docs deploy window.
maria: confirmed on prod — link fixed. closing thread. :tada:
